name: Harmony 350, Watch TV after a restart over USB
description: On lab/work/350-every-key/every-key.bin, written again so that the write ends with the reboot command. Watch TV was silent in three runs that each followed such a write with no battery pull between, and has sent Info in every run since a battery pull. This run checks whether the restart over USB is what leaves it silent, and whether a battery pull brings it back.

steps.instruction: The remote has just been written and restarted over USB. Unplug it, do not take the batteries out, and point it at the receiver
Press Watch TV once, before any other key
Press TV/Media once and briefly, then Watch TV once
Press Menu once, the control on Watch TV's column wire
If Watch TV was silent: take the batteries out, put them back, and press Watch TV once more
